body: WOW Wait i say it again WOW.This movie is truly unique.Every set piece of this movie is full of laughing house.Forget about script and plot.Its all about dialogs.A must watch movie for everyone.Hats off to MR.Ananta Jalil for his exceptional performance.I just wish Charley Chaplin would be alive just to see this movie.Even the actions are comedic.the genre is totally new for our movie industry.you will be laughing out of your seat even on the most heartbreaking moments.cant say anything more just watch it.the chemistry between Borsha and Ananta is top notch.direction is excellent.This a true movie revelation for Bangladesh.

AJ has been absolutely amazing since his inception in the local movie industry. In the past 4 years, I've watched 6 Bangladeshi movies only. Interestingly, 4 of them were produced, directed and acted by Ananta Jalil. Regardless of his 'comedy of errors' and 'mind-boggling English pronunciation', he has thrown a great challenge to the experienced directors of the country.

Along with Borsha's acting, the couple has managed to produce movies with absolutely 'Zero' adult content and still managed to bring in highest number of box office sales in the past couple of years!

Undoubtedly, due to Ananta's fun-filled, action oriented evolution in the market, the entire industry is gradually adopting global sense of video production. Hats off to all his consistent efforts!

Yes. It is. Mark my word fellas. If you do not hurt your stomach laughing your buttocks off, I will go and drown myself in the river of Buriganga. Good things about the movie: Casting, Plot, Character Development and everything that is needed to make an epic movie. Bad thing: Not enough dancing moves from the great Ananta sir. Just bring your friends or cousins in with you and get ready for the most entertaining 2 hours of your life. And yeah, don't forget to breath. At times, the movie gets so intense that there is a good chance you may forget to breath or mistake the old lady sitting beside you for your long- awaited girlfriend.

I have seen "Khoj The Search" by Ananta Jalil. I laughed when Ananta act in serious scenes. Everybody in the theater laughed out loud. He cannot act but it was so funny to watch his acting.

Normally people watch Ananta Jalil's film to get entertained by hearing his dialogs. His acting's too much funny. In films Ananta Jalil can do anything, even if he needs to fly, he will fly. But this film made some sense.

The music and lyrics of the songs are nice, background scenes are awesome, only problem is that both of Ananta Jalil and Barsha cannot dance.

No more funny dialogs this time, not much. If you expect to get entertained by his meaningless funny dialogs like before, you won't get much. His acting's improved. He didn't talk much. But the problem is that Barsha cannot act, she is far below the average.

I can say that the story is good. You will get interested to see the end while watching the film. The finishing is okay but the starting is very typical.

At last, I will say that I liked the film, far better than previous films. I hope Ananta Jalil will learn more and I specially hope that the action scenes will improve in future.

There is not enough words in the English dictionary (I'm afraid may be not in any dictionary) to express the awesomeness of this movie. If you love to love, like to love and want to love, go watch it immediately. This movie is all about love; in fact it redefined "What is Love?"

The action and comedy scenes are so much real that you may even think that this movie is not produced in this planet.

The chemistry between Ananta and Barsha is heavenly, charming and out of the world, as the entire movie is.

The movie has a lot to offer to everyone, from its general viewers to the cardiac surgeons. If someone said me that a person can take off his heart and can still be alive, I would call him a weed or mad, but not anymore. Sir Ananta Jalil actually deserves Nobel prize for this innovation.

Summary: There are 10 types of people in this world; those who watched this movie and those who don't know "what is love".
